provinceDeepAtlasProfile.oneLine: El'dravire Riverrealm is centered at -16.033105, 61.118515 under Parliamentary Government, with 133,430,000 people across 12 settlements.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.extremeAtlasDescription: El'dravire Riverrealm occupies 6,815,430.47 sq mi / 17,651,883.88 sq km of modeled Earth-sized territory, about 3.460707% of Belavadös's surface. It is not merely a province but a continent-scale civic machine: Beach and grass with water, Partial forest and Beach and reefs with water define its broad terrain, while its settlements intensify into Beach and grass with water, Farming, Marshes and swamps, Beach and reefs with water and Ocean Surface floating settlement. Population density is 7.559 people/sq km / 19.578 people/sq mi, which lets wilderness, roads, faction-held corridors, and vast uncrowded borders remain huge.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.peopleFactionsAndFaith: The strongest public people-groups are Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, Halfling and Smallfolk, Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, Elf Parent Race and Elf Bloodlines, Amphibious and Aquatic Peoples, Fey and Trickster Folk, and 2 more. Frequently recorded peoples include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Harengon, Elf — Wood Elf, Elf — Eladrin, Fey-Folk — Faerie, Satyr, Changeling, and 4 more. Faction visibility leans toward The Black-Maw Myriad, with worship and patronage records naming Nebyrr, Ishtanora, Iskareth, Thoryn-Rahek, Bastveig, Sigrananna, Hathruna, and 3 more.

npcs.name: Sull Mathis
npcs.description: Sull Mathis is a clever Geisamahi excavator with muddy boots, nimble hands, and a talent for making dangerous work sound like a simple paid errand. At the Fael'ryss Tavern, he hires help to drain old worksites, open buried channels, and expose sealed machinery, but the Brass Concordat suspects his digs are less about honest excavation and more about finding ichor-stained underworks before officials can claim them. He is useful, funny, and deeply untrustworthy when there is treasure under the floor.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Fael'ryss is a Town in El'dravire Riverrealm, under Parliamentary Government, with moderate danger, Beach and grass with water, Partial forest, Marshes and swamps terrain. Local records favor Altruistic, Neutral, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Elf — Wood Elf, Elf — Eladrin, Fey-Folk — Faerie. Geisamahi reads through the Geisamahi entry of the race compendium, within Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, marked by Iskareth. Small Ferretfolk Tinkerers, Scouts, and Clever Problem-Solvers. Table cues: ancestral instincts, homeland pressure, and local reputation; starting tendency Altruistic - Chaotic - Cooperative - Honorable.
rumors: Sull Mathis knows why an ichor ledger changed hands last Anubaday.
Sull Mathis has a contact in Brassmere Concord who will deny everything.
plotHooks: Sull Mathis asks the party to protect a household member without revealing why.
